init_distributed_process_group: initialize a distributed process group using torch.distributed with the given args and backend
infer_distributed_init_method: infer the distributed init method from environment variables for Slurm or torch.distributed.launch
gather_data_from_all_workers: gather arbitrary picklable data from all distributed workers into a single list
suppress_non_master_print: suppress print output on non-master processes in a distributed training setup
check_master_process: check if the current process is the master process by comparing distributed rank to zero
